newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel says losses from plant fire unknown.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel says losses from plant fire unknown.

text.p: Nippon Steel Corp said on Wednesday that it could not yet estimate damage and losses from a fire on Tuesday at its Oita plant in western Japan.

The fire broke out around 11 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday and was extinguished late at night, a company spokesman said. No injuries were reported, but the fire halted operation of its hot-rolling line, which was still shut down, he said.
The extent of the damage and losses may become clear by the end of this week, the spokesman said. Nippon Steel makes hot-rolled steel sheets and coils at other plants, he said.
